## Page 5

Micro Leasing Public Company Limited (“MICRO”) was established in 1994 and is principally engaged in providing hire purchase loans to individual and corporate 
customers who intend to purchase commercial vehicles such as 6 -wheel trucks, 10 -wheel trucks, trailers, and commercial trucks un its for use in their business. The 
company focuses on providing truck leasing services on models and brands that are marketable in Thailand, such as ISUZU, HINO and FUSO, etc., with lease term of 
approximately 12 -60 months, with interest rate from 8 -15% per year (flat rate).
